cells.gaps: No source found since October 2023 says a law, decree or policy in force classifies government data or requires it to be held in the country; the administration data centre (COM-002, COM-003) does not answer that.
cells.note: Reassessed under Bill's ruling of 2026-10-31 (every lower rung shown by its own evidence): the national data governance strategy validated in August 2026 makes data sovereignty its first axis (COM-001), so stage 2. The ANADEN-run administration data centre hosts critical services (COM-003), but no rule on state data is in force, so hosting no longer lifts the cell to 4.
